nodes.description: Public constant-like state variable of type string holding a large base64-encoded woff2 font data URI, initialized at deployment.
Public view function getDamien() with no parameters or local variables; it reads the 'damien' state variable and returns it as a string. No external calls, no arithmetic, no access control.

edges.reason: getDamien() reads the state variable 'damien' and returns its value to the caller; the only data flow in the contract is from the state variable into the function's return value.
